anomalies.observed: The netlist contains two microcontrollers, U2 (ATtiny45-20P) and U3 (ATtiny13V-10S), wired in parallel on all signal and power pins: both VCC pins are on +5V, both GND pins are on GND, and PB0/PB1/PB2/PB3/PB4/PB5 are tied to SDA/PWM/SCK/POT/TACH/RST respectively.
anomalies.expected: The specification describes an ATtiny-driven fan controller (singular), and standard practice for this simple controller is a single active MCU. If alternate footprints are provided, only one should be populated/isolated; otherwise the second MCU should not be connected as an active device.
anomalies.impact: If both U2 and U3 are populated, their push-pull outputs will contend on PWM, SCK, SDA, reset, and other shared pins, likely preventing normal fan control and potentially damaging the MCUs. The board would not behave as a single-ATtiny fan controller.

parsed.summary: The passive values and power connectivity look broadly plausible, but the netlist shows two ATtiny microcontrollers wired in parallel on all nets, which is inconsistent with a single ATtiny-driven fan controller and would cause output contention if both are populated.
